title: State v. Rosario (N.J. 2017)
key_points: Holding: Pulling in behind a parked car in a driveway and activating overhead lights turned an encounter into an investigative detention that required reasonable suspicion.
officer_notes: Scenario: You see a woman sitting in a parked car at night, pull your unit behind it and turn on your overheads to check on her.
Takeaway: Lights and blocking a car's exit can create a seizure; have reasonable suspicion or a true welfare-check basis.
